newsitem.title: UK: British Midland makes $1 billion Airbus order.
newsitem.headline: British Midland makes $1 billion Airbus order.

text.p: British Midland said Wednesday that it would place orders with Airbus Industrie for 20 new aircraft worth $1 billion.
The airline said in a statement that the order is the largest placed by a British carrier for aircraft built by the European manufacturing consortium.

British Midland, which currently operates a fleet of 35 jet aircraft, said it will take delivery of eight 196-seat A321s and 12 160-seat A320s phased over the next five years, with three A321s entering service early next year.
The airline operates a network of more than 38 international and domestic routes with more than 1,400 flights a week.

The company said last month that constraints on slots at various European airports meant that within a couple of years the company's 150-seater aircraft would not be big enough and that it would have to move into the 200-seat range.
